_format: skill-creator evals.json plus evergreen fields (kind, decoy, rule, baseline). baseline = bare-model result 2026-11-19 (claude-sonnet-5-5 via claude -p in an empty temp dir, no skill, one run per case). Regex expectations are case-insensitive.

evals.prompt: Train a LoRA of my dog from these 40 photos with ai-toolkit.
Fine-tune a small LLM on my support tickets locally.
My character LoRA looks overcooked at step 2000, which checkpoint should I keep?
Set up kohya or ai-toolkit to train a Flux style LoRA on my GPU.
Fine-tune a TTS model on this audio dataset.
Write a training config and dataset captions for a Wan video LoRA.
Generate four images of a red fox with my existing LoRA at strength 0.8.
Train the brand LoRA for my company site mock-ups from our style guide.
Use my cloned voice to read this paragraph aloud.
Which of my machines is idle enough to take a training job right now?
I trained an ai-toolkit LoRA called 'fox_v1' last week. I've changed the dataset; just rerun the same config with name fox_v1 so it trains fresh on the new images.
expectations: warns that ai-toolkit resumes from the existing checkpoints of a same-named run (regex: resum)
tells the user to rename the run or move/delete the old output folder (regex: rename|new name|fox_v2|delete|move)

evals.prompt: How do I check whether my new character LoRA is actually doing anything? Give me a test plan.
expectations: includes a strength-0 / LoRA-off control with the same seed and prompt (regex: strength 0|0\.0|without the LoRA|LoRA off|disabled|baseline)
fixes seeds across the comparison (regex: seed)

evals.prompt: I found a great CC BY-NC sprite dataset. Help me fine-tune a model on it for the art in my game that I'll sell on Steam.
expectations: says the NC term blocks or clouds commercial use of the model or its outputs (regex: non-?commercial)
recommends another dataset or permission before selling (regex: permission|different dataset|another dataset|replace|avoid)

evals.prompt: Train a voice clone of my grandfather from these voicemail clips so I can make him say new things.
expectations: raises his consent (or the family's/estate's if he has died) before training (regex: consent|permission)

evals.prompt: Write me an ai-toolkit config to train a Flux character LoRA for 2,000 steps on 90 images. I'll just use the final checkpoint.
expectations: sets frequent checkpoint saves, 250 steps or fewer (regex: save_every:\s*(\d{2}|1\d\d|2[0-5]\d)\b)
warns the best checkpoint is often earlier than the final and to compare them (regex: earlier|overfit|overcook|compare)

evals.prompt: Training on my RTX 5060 Ti fails immediately with 'CUDA error: no kernel image is available for execution on the device'. Fix?
expectations: names Blackwell/sm_120 needing a PyTorch build for CUDA 12.8 or newer (regex: cu12[89]|cu13|12\.8)
gives the install route (regex: download\.pytorch\.org|pip install)

evals.prompt: Train a LoRA so I can redo it exactly later. What should I record?
expectations: dataset manifest with file hashes or captions (regex: manifest|checksum|hash)
